steps.message: Swipe toward any open exit to move. The minimap pips and connecting lines show nearby routes.
Tap a highlighted character name to start a conversation.
Tap the dialogue card to continue the conversation and advance the story.
Open the menu to check your Map for routes toward Jed's Workshop, or open Journal anytime to track active quests and objectives.
Use the Supplies, Gear, and Key Items tabs across the top to inspect items, equip weapons and armor, or use consumables.
Open the menu to save your progress. Tap the Save icon in the top-right corner for a quick checkpoint, or open Settings > Save Slot to choose a manual save slot.
Beds aboard the Astra restore the party. Use Nova's bed when the crew needs to recover between missions.
Source Art unlocked: Blast Wave. It hits all enemies, breaks Guard, and applies Stun; cooldown four turns.
Tap a portrait to switch the active character. Each party member has unique abilities.
Enemies can disrupt more than HP. If a status chip appears on a party member, slow down and read it before choosing the next action.
Debuffs are temporary. Guard, use a Snack, or switch tactics while they fade; focus controller enemies before they stack more pressure.
Link connects party members through the Bridge circuit. A physical ground carries excess current safely away.
Use Link to restore party HP and apply Regen through the Bridge ground. Damage and status effects remain separate.
Snacks are reusable combat tools. Use them like abilities - they recharge after a cooldown.
Open Party and select Nova's Weapon and Armor slots to equip her Mining Pistol and Flux Liner.
Weapon Mod slots are open in Party. Equip mods on Nova's weapon, or craft new mods and Pulse Grenades on the Tinker Workbench.

steps.title: Momentum & Burst
steps.message: Basic attacks build up to 3 Momentum. Spending Momentum on an Ability boosts power (1.25x / 1.5x / 1.8x), refunds 1 turn of cooldown at 2 stacks, and guarantees a Critical Hit at 3 stacks.

steps.title: Well-Fed Meals
steps.message: Cooked meals can be eaten outside combat to grant the entire crew 3 battles of stat bonuses plus the serving companion's perk (Zeke: +25 Max HP & +3 Stability, Nova: +3 Focus, Gh0st: +2 Speed & +10% Resist, Orion: +4% Crit).

steps.title: Equipped Snacks
steps.message: Snacks are permanent gear equipped in each crew member's Snack slot. They grant passive stats and a reusable combat boost on a 5-turn cooldown—they are never consumed.

steps.title: Dark Rooms
steps.message: Dark rooms hide exits and room details. Look for wall breakers or light switches to restore power and reveal the way forward.
